_why_in_set: KRAS validated the method on a clean, well-behaved 2019 monomer. Running the same pipeline on immunology targets broke it three separate ways within one invocation. These are the failure modes real targets produce and the oncology fixtures never surface — recorded so a recompile knows they were found by execution, not imagined.
_how: Deployed Modal app druggability-pocket-scan, workspace rafwiewiora, run on IL-17A holo entries 8USS / 9SQX / 8DYG.

FAILURE_1_no_legacy_pdb_format.cause: RCSB no longer issues legacy PDB format for newer depositions.
FAILURE_1_no_legacy_pdb_format.why_it_matters_here: Immunology structures skew recent. IL-17A's small-molecule series begins 2016 (5HI3) and several entries are from 2025. A pdb-only fetcher fails on exactly the entries where new chemistry lives. KRAS never exposed this — 6OIM is 2019 and has both formats.
FAILURE_1_no_legacy_pdb_format.fix: Fetch mmCIF and treat it as the source of truth; convert to PDB only as fpocket's input, since fpocket accepts nothing else.

FAILURE_2_five_character_ligand_codes.symptom: 9SQX returned ligand_site_residues = 0 and ligand_site_copy = null despite being a holo structure with a bound drug-like ligand.
FAILURE_2_five_character_ligand_codes.cause: The ligand is `A1JPS` — FIVE characters. The PDB chemical component dictionary exhausted 3-character codes. Legacy PDB format has exactly three columns for the component ID (line[17:20]), so a 5-character code is not merely mis-parsed, it is unrepresentable in the format.
FAILURE_2_five_character_ligand_codes.downstream_damage: No ligand site -> no ground truth -> selection falls back to 'most druggable pocket anywhere' -> at D=2.4 it picked a 3606 A^3 merge artifact and reported it as the site.
FAILURE_2_five_character_ligand_codes.why_it_matters: This is silent. The run exits 0 and returns a confident-looking number for the wrong pocket.
FAILURE_2_five_character_ligand_codes.fix: Parse ligands from mmCIF via gemmi, never from PDB columns.

FAILURE_3_site_recovery_is_worse_than_KR.note: Even with the ligand correctly identified, IL-17A site recovery is materially worse than KRAS. 8USS's site is only 15 residues and 8DYG's 13, against KRAS's 22 — a shallow interface groove rather than an enclosed pocket. Whether this reflects the site's real character or a prep problem is UNRESOLVED and must not be assumed either way.
FAILURE_3_site_recovery_is_worse_than_KR.status: OPEN — do not treat IL-17A pocket numbers as validated.

FAILURE_4_multichain_merge.symptom: 9SQX prepped with chains A,B,C,D produced a 3606 A^3 pocket at D=2.4; 8DYG with A,B produced 1074 A^3.
FAILURE_4_multichain_merge.cause: Chain selection defaults to every chain present. On a multi-copy asymmetric unit, adjacent and crystal-contact sites fuse.
FAILURE_4_multichain_merge.related: The same default silently changed KRAS 4OBE numbers between the calibration (chain A only: druggability 0.442, rank 1) and the deployed run (chains A+B: 0.257, rank 6). Same structure, same clustering, different answer.
FAILURE_4_multichain_merge.fix: Chain selection must be explicit per target, decided from where the site is. IL-17A's site is at the homodimer interface, so it needs exactly two chains — not one, not four.

WHAT_KRAS_COULD_NOT_HAVE_TOLD_US: 6OIM is a 2019 entry with both file formats, a 3-character ligand code, and one relevant chain.
Every one of the four failures above requires a structure that is recent, multi-chain, or both.
A fixture set drawn only from well-studied oncology targets validates the happy path and nothing else.

il17a_context.site_character: groove at the homodimer interface, not an enclosed pocket
il17a_context.first_small_molecule_structure: 5HI3, 2016-08-31, a macrocycle — roughly one year AFTER the first antibody approval
il17a_context.contrast_with_tnf_alpha: Both are cytokines, both PPI targets, both drugged with antibodies first. TNF-alpha's site is a cavity on the trimer 3-fold axis opened by displacing a subunit; IL-17A's is a dimer-interface groove. Same class, unrelated pocket topology — the reason family-level druggability transfer does not work and pocket-level transfer might.
